{"formatted_summary": "🛡️ **PMFBY — Crop Insurance**
Benefit: Full crop loss coverage, 1.5% premium for Rabi
Eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops
How to apply: pmfby.gov.in or bank branch before sowing
Deadline: Enroll before sowing season
---
💳 **Kisan Credit Card**
Benefit: Loan up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest
Eligibility: All farmers with land records
How to apply: Any nationalized bank with land documents
Deadline: Ongoing
---
☀️ **PM Kusum — Solar Pump**
Benefit: 90% subsidy on solar irrigation pump
Eligibility: Farmers with no grid electricity or high bills
How to apply: upagricultural.com or District Agriculture Office
Deadline: Apply before March 31
---
🏥 **Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana**
Benefit: ₹5 lakh accident insurance for farmer and family
Eligibility: All UP farmers
How to apply: Tehsil office with Khatoni and Aadhaar
Deadline: Ongoing
---
🧪 **Soil Health Card**
Benefit: Free soil testing + fertilizer recommendation
Eligibility: All farmers
How to apply: Nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra
